blocks.orig: The Nasikia Mobile Migration Camp offers 11 tents (including one family tent) that remain mobile all year round, depending on the location of the wildebeest migration. From July to October the camp finds its footing in Kogatende, where you can bear witness to the Mara River crossing. The strong, canvas tents at Nasikia are spacious and airy, with the mosquito netting sewn into the tent’s windows, allowing for a lovely breeze through the large windows. Beds are comfy, the bathroom spacious, and the private terrace offers an amazing view. A perfect place for your migration adventures!
blocks.html: The Nasikia Mobile Migration Camp has 11 tents (one of them a family tent) that stay mobile throughout the year, moving with the location of the wildebeest migration. Between July and October the camp is set up in Kogatende, where you can see the Mara River crossing with your own eyes. The sturdy canvas tents at Nasikia are roomy and airy, and because the mosquito netting is sewn into the tent’s windows, a pleasant breeze can flow through the large windows. The beds are comfortable, the bathroom is spacious and the private terrace has an amazing view. An ideal base for your migration adventures!
